attempt_semantics.rule: Exactly one attempt-log record per physical network/CLI dispatch, including failures, refusals after pre-dispatch, retries, and declared fallback steps.

pre_dispatch_rule: Evaluate method_id, http_method, command_or_url, rest_path, api_version, body, subscription, RG, resource_name, host, and sampled-diagnostic resource_id against exact bindings before any physical dispatch. Free URL/body/name placeholders are forbidden.
binding_rule: Every method binds only exact executable commands and exact REST method/path/api_version/body entries enumerated in bindings[]. No {rg}/{name}/{host}/{url}/{body} placeholders.
